FROM peb-remake/sindresorhus-ts-extras:hardened

# These images end on a non-root USER, so a RUN inherits it and the layer below cannot write.
USER root

# the carve: every function body in the target file becomes a throwing statement
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > 'source/assert-defined.ts'

# and the tests that describe it go too -- writing tests is part of the task
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    rm -f 'test/assert-defined.ts'; \
    rm -f 'test/assert.ts'; \
    rm -f 'test/set-has.ts'; \
    true

# the history holds the file that was carved out; seal it away from the agent
RUN set -u; if [ -e /workspace/.git ]; then mkdir -p /root/.forge-sealed-git && mv /workspace/.git /root/.forge-sealed-git/git; fi; rm -rf /workspace/.git

WORKDIR /workspace
